title: 第1章 全侯府最大的笑话第2章 金手指买一赠一 Buff叠满
slug: 未婚当奶娘可她婴语满级啊
content_zh:
苏念禾死了。
在一次救助中发生了意外。
作为某军区妇幼医院最权威最年轻的教授，可以说她的一生辉煌且绚烂。
要说她最大的遗憾，那就是没有养个崽崽rua！
她这么喜欢孩子，医院里的根本不够rua，好嘛！
苏念禾还没来得及叹气，耳朵边就响起一阵哄笑声。
“要我说啊，她这分明就是个小骗子，想混进侯府骗吃骗喝……”
“又或者，她不是骗子，是……小偷？嘿嘿嘿……”
有人惊呼起来：“偷……偷人？就她那瘦不拉几的，要啥没啥，还想攀高枝？”
“咯咯咯，都成整个侯府最大的笑话了，还杵在那里赖着不走，脸皮啊真够厚的了！”
“就是说啊，没奶还想充娘？也不掂量掂量自己是个什么货色？”
“好事不出门，坏事传千里。想必明天，她可就是全京城最大的笑话了……”
“我呸！跟这样的乡下人同时竞争，真是掉身价！”
在一浪赛过一浪的嗤笑声中，苏念禾满脑子问号？
哈？
什么情况？
进侯门……当奶娘？
要知道想让她看一眼孩子，那可都是千金难求！
苏念禾揉了揉太阳穴，猛然睁开了双眼。
青砖黛瓦！

高门大户！
还有一群穿着古代服饰双手叉腰，傲然挺胸的长舌妇！
随后灵魂一震：我，穿越了？
突然，她的脑袋传来一阵刺痛，无数记忆波涛汹涌般涌了进来。
她的确穿越了。
确切的说，她是魂穿到了架空古代大夏国一个偏远京郊的小村姑身上。
原主也叫苏念禾，不满15岁，家里就是老实本分的庄稼人，赋税繁重，弟、妹众多，很久没有吃过饱饭了。
为了给家里减轻负担，给弟弟妹妹多挣些口粮，她就远上京城来讨生活。
本来她打算找个粗使丫头的活儿，一步一步来，毕竟自己是乡下来的。
没想到刚到京城就看到太平侯府招人，阴错阳差随着乌泱泱的人群进了后院。
她一出现，可谓是吸引了所有人的目光。
那些陌生带着敌意的目光，在她的上身游走。
很快，目光流转，那些敌意就变成了戏虐。
都是生养过的妇人，又是当过奶娘的老人儿，眼睛毒得很，自然能看出苏念禾还是个黄花大闺女，根本就没有奶水。
“哎呦喂，真是林子大了什么鸟都有，就你也想进侯府？”
说话的名叫王翠娥，用手托了托自己的波涛汹涌，意味深长地说：“我们有的，你有吗？”
“咯咯咯……”
风韵犹存的沈春花笑得弯了腰：“小妮子，还没及笄吧，人都没长开呢！
还不快点儿滚回去喝奶去？”
不少妇人捂着嘴：“别痴心妄想了，侯府出价再高，你也摸不着……”

她们各自心里想着：侯府奶娘只能是自己！
所谓敌人的敌人就是朋友。
她们同仇敌忾赶走一个就少一个对手。
content_en:
Su Nianhe is dead.
An accident occurred during a rescue operation.
As the most authoritative and youngest professor at a maternal and child hospital in a certain military region, it can be said that her life was brilliant and splendid.
Her biggest regret is not raising a Zaizai Rua!
She loves children so much, the ones in the hospital are simply not enough, okay!
Before Su Nianhe could sigh, a burst of laughter rang in his ears.
"Let me tell you, she is obviously a little liar. She wants to sneak into the Marquis's mansion and cheat her out of food and drink..."
"Or maybe she's not a liar, but...a thief? Hehehe..."
Someone exclaimed: "Stealing...stealing? She is so skinny, she wants nothing, but she still wants to climb a high tree?"
"Giggle, giggle, it has become the biggest joke in the entire Hou family. You are still hanging there and won't leave. You are really thick-skinned!"
"You mean, you want to pretend to be a mother if you don't have breasts? You don't even think about who you are?"
"Good things don't go out, and bad things spread thousands of miles. I think tomorrow, she will be the biggest joke in the whole capital..."
"Bah! Competing with such a countryman at the same time is really a loss of status!"
Amidst the waves of laughter, Su Nianhe's mind was filled with questions?
ha?
What's going on?
Enter the Hou family...become a nanny?
You know, if you want her to see the child, it's hard to get!
Su Nianhe rubbed his temples and suddenly opened his eyes.
Green bricks and black tiles!
A wealthy family!
There are also a group of long-tongued women wearing ancient costumes with their hands on their hips and proudly sticking out their chests!
Then my soul was shocked: I have traveled through time?
Suddenly, there was a stabbing pain in her head, and countless memories rushed in like waves.
She did travel through time.
To be precise, her soul traveled through the body of a small village girl in a remote suburb of Beijing in the fictional ancient country of Daxia.
The original owner, also named Su Nianhe, was under 15 years old. His family was an honest farmer with heavy taxes, many younger brothers and sisters, and he had not had enough to eat for a long time.
In order to reduce the burden on her family and earn more food for her younger siblings, she went to the capital to earn a living.
Originally, she planned to find a job as a maid and take it step by step. After all, she came from the countryside.
Unexpectedly, as soon as he arrived in the capital, he saw the Taiping Hou Mansion recruiting people, and by some strange combination of circumstances, he followed the huge crowd into the backyard.
As soon as she appeared, she attracted everyone's attention.
The hostile eyes of those strangers roamed over her upper body.
Soon, the eyes changed, and the hostility turned into teasing.
They were all women who had given birth, and they were old men who had worked as wet nurses. Their eyes were very poisonous, and they could naturally tell that Su Nianhe was still a young girl with no milk at all.
"Hey, the forest is really big and there are all kinds of birds. Are you the only one who wants to enter the Marquis' Mansion?"
The speaker's name was Wang Cui'e. She held her own turbulent waves with her hands and said meaningfully: "We have it, do you have it?"
"Kekeke..."
Shen Chunhua, whose charm was still there, smiled so much that she bent over: "Xiao Nizi, you haven't even grown hair yet!
Why don't you go back and drink milk quickly? "
Many women covered their mouths: "Don't have such wishful thinking. No matter how high the Marquis' price is, you can't touch it..."
They each thought in their hearts: The nanny of the Hou Mansion can only be themselves!
The so-called enemy of my enemy is my friend.
If they drive away the same enemy, they will have one less opponent.
